Ana Blackwood
ana.blackwood@example.com | Kansas City, MO
Ana Blackwood has 4 years of experience in mobile. Most recently, Mobile
Engineer at Quartzline Computing (2024-2026), where they built the company's
React Native app end to end, shipped to 253K users. Before that, Junior Mobile
Engineer at Northbeam Digital (2022-2024). Education: B.S. Information Systems,
University of Cincinnati, 2021. Core skills: Android, Node.js, REST API design,
REST API design, PostgreSQL, Kotlin, iOS, TypeScript, GraphQL.
